privacy_note: On-screen and notification text is reduced to typed tokens; only amounts, distances, minutes, clock times, counts and fixed UI vocabulary keep values. Single exception: the pickup restaurant name from an offer card (pickup_names), stored only if it has no phone or long number. Destinations/addresses are never stored.
acceptance_note: A notification being removed does NOT mean the offer was accepted or declined. Offer outcome is unknown unless labeled by the user.
